question: Under NPCDCS, a PHC physician should screen all patients aged 30 years and above attending the OPD for hypertension and diabetes, even if they present for an unrelated complaint.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: Under NPCDCS, opportunistic screening of all patients aged ≥30 years attending OPD is mandatory — not just those presenting with NCD symptoms. This is a key strategy for early detection.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. NPCDCS mandates opportunistic screening of all OPD attendees ≥30 years for hypertension, diabetes, and common cancers, regardless of the presenting complaint.
